improvements: Running Sessions in the left sidebar now use the same ambient text treatment as Thinking activity.
The Desktop connection screen now separates first-time setup from endpoint changes.
Manual Desktop update checks now report when the installed version is current.
fixes: Conversation history hidden with `/clear` now stays hidden for that Session after refresh, reconnect, or service restart.
The right sidebar now defaults to Files and restores the last selected tab independently for each Session.
Linux Desktop microphone requests now use an explicit, origin-scoped native permission flow.
Copilot CLI discovery now remains available after a local redeployment.
knownIssues: Desktop microphone permission has been validated by automated native tests; installation still requires the normal operating-system permission prompt.
